notes.title: New Update - Change quality level. VR edition.
notes.content:
New update brings some new features and bugfixes.

Build 4651793 contains:


 Quality level - if game runs slow on you computer, you can change quality level 
 VR support - play on HTC Vive 
 Minor improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: New Update - bigger inventory and difficulty level!
notes.content:
We listen to your suggestions! New update brings some expected features.

Build 4615633 contains:

 Unlimited inventory - now you can keep all interesting stuff you found in the woods!
 Difficulty level - choose Easy and enjoy all crafting formulas from the beginning of the game. Easy level means also: more gold and milder reputation rating by villagers. 
 Minor improvements and bug fixes.
